CustomObject.description: One entry in the organization's own list of volunteer skills and interests, for example Spanish or Forklift licence. Volunteer skills and job skills point at it. Sharing is Read, so everyone sees the list; Volunteers Admin and Volunteers Coordinator hold View All and Modify All because they keep the one list for everyone, renaming or deleting a skill someone else added, and the platform grants edit and delete on another person's record only with Modify All. Read Write sharing would not do: deleting still needs Modify All.
CustomObject.label: Skill
